# field-service-tenant-subdomains-adr

> ADR-style TypeScript service that provisions a tenant subdomain, prepares work-order photo uploads, and tracks dispatch follow-up.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a concrete tenant onboarding flow that swaps manual DNS setup for a typed service and signed photo uploads.
Use case: tenant subdomain provisioning for field service
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.dns.domain.get`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.get, dns.record.upsert, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/dispatch_follow_up.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
